name: Wrist blaster
description: A wrist blaster was a blaster weapon worn and fired from a wrist. B2-series super battle droids, built by Baktoid Combat Automata, had built-in wrist blasters as their main weapon. The bounty hunter C-21 Highsinger had a wrist blaster built into his arm. A Dur-24 wrist laser was favored by the bounty hunter Boba Fett.
